summary: Universal Health Services (UHS) filed an 8-K reporting the closing of its acquisition of Talkspace, Inc. via merger on August 17, 2026. Each TalkSpace share converted into $5.25 cash, and UHS borrowed $400 million under a delayed draw term loan plus additional revolver funds to finance the deal. Vested options and RSUs were cancelled, while unvested awards converted into UHS Class B equity. The Credit Agreement terms were previously disclosed. Watch for integration execution and any post-closing adjustments.
